name: Object Storage
description: Generic object storage browser for Alibaba Cloud OSS and S3-compatible services (MinIO, AWS S3, R2, COS, OBS, B2...). Server-side pagination with list virtualization, chunked upload, presigned URL sharing, file preview, and multi-select batch delete/download.
releaseNotes: First generic release: StorageDriver abstraction (Aliyun OSS native + S3-compatible via minio-go), large-directory pagination, chunked upload, presigned sharing, file preview (image/video/audio/pdf/text/code/markdown), multi-select batch delete/download.

zh-CN.name: 对象存储
zh-CN.description: 通用对象存储浏览器：支持阿里云 OSS 与 S3 兼容服务（MinIO、AWS S3、R2、COS、OBS、B2 等）。大目录服务端分页、分片上传、预签名分享、文件预览、多选批量删除/下载。
